admission.justification: Four custody symbols across three archive modules state one retry obligation no single place states alone; three proving tests pin the refusals and the restoration.

applicability: Sprint-archive retries and resumed first-phase moves.
conditions: A record from the same reason and selection exists.
exclusions: First attempts with no prior record; masters another live sprint keeps.

evidence: M1 verdict L82-MEM-M1-F01 + R4 evidence: test_sprint_archive_custody.py::test_recorded_retry_refuses_missing_master_custody; ::test_recorded_retry_refuses_changed_archived_sprint_bytes; ::test_resumed_prefix_failure_restores_all_and_removes_record; test_recorded_boundaries.py::test_each_recorded_move_boundary_resumes_truthfully; notes/repo

statement: A same-request archive retry compares against its recorded reason and selection: it refuses on missing master custody or changed archived bytes, and a resumed move failure restores every folder and removes the record.
